author: Chris Cooley
name: Byte Runner
tagline: Follow the bites. Eat the page.
description: A hungry pixel frog scrambles through the webpage. Follow food trails between the UI, grab glowing power squares, chase flies, and eat real page text.
versionNote: Food trails. Tiny feet. A very real page.
controls: Arrows / WASD / touch D-pad — move through the page
Follow the food or leave the trail to eat page text
P — pause · G — next area · Esc — Recall

chapters.title: The UI is the terrain.
chapters.body: Pixel food trails follow gaps between real text, buttons, and page elements. Leave a trail whenever you want to eat the page. Clear the small and glowing squares to advance; real letters are optional extra food and turn into actual 0s and 1s.

chapters.title: Big glow. Bigger appetite.
chapters.body: Glowing pink power pellets turn flies blue for six seconds, stacking up to nine. Hunt them for 100, 200, 300, then 400 points. Cherries and strawberries appear on the trails for bonus points; fruit is optional and does not grant power.

chapters.title: Small feet. Big appetite.
chapters.body: The frog’s feet scramble only while it moves, with a separate chomp when it eats. Violet flies pursue directly, pink flies anticipate your heading, and cyan Roamers mix pursuit with wandering. Flies follow the corridor graph; their wings never let them cross its walls.

chapters.title: The DOM carries the trails.
chapters.body: The trail layout, pellets, fruit, and pixel sprites are native SVG children attached inside your content root. They follow scrolling and transforms even while paused. The active trail layout adapts to a changed viewport while preserving progress; it never earns points or clears a level by resizing.

extra: Three lives. Levels advance by clearing food. The roster grows from three flies toward a cap of eight. Recall removes the creatures and food and restores game-owned text edits.

characters.name: Byte Runner
characters.rules: A round green frog with tiny scrambling feet. Follow the food, or roam off the trail and eat real page letters. Its mouth chomps independently while it runs.

characters.name: Chaser
characters.rules: The violet fly takes a corridor route toward your position. Unpowered contact costs a life.

characters.name: Interceptor
characters.rules: The pink fly aims several junctions ahead of your heading. Turn to change its interception point.

characters.name: Roamer
characters.rules: The cyan fly mixes fast pursuit with roaming at junctions. Its wings stay within the corridor routes.

characters.name: Vulnerable flies
characters.rules: A glowing power pellet seals the gates temporarily. Blue flies flee along the maze and become edible. Chain catches for increasing points.

characters.name: Power pellet
characters.rules: The large glowing pixel squares give six seconds of power, capped at nine when stacked. They count toward clearing the level.

characters.name: Bonus fruit
characters.rules: Cherries and strawberries appear on the corridors. Catch them before they disappear; they are optional bonus food.
